summary: No open repository table gives growth-rate-versus-temperature curves or fitted optima across many temperate plant species plus maize and melon; what exists is single-species TPC data (Mimulus guttatus, Dryad CC0), a 21-species temperate weed seedling growth/germination table (Dryad/Zenodo CC0) without a temperature series to the optimum, and cardinal-temperature compilations for fungi only; TRY holds no such trait and EDI's search API was unreachable.
next_step: Compile per-species cardinal/optimum temperatures from the agronomic and plant-physiology literature (crop cardinal-temperature reviews, root-elongation studies such as those Thompson cites from Sachs and Pfeffer) into one table with species, organ, stage and optimum, then pre-register the temperate-vs-warm-climate comparison.
obstacles_confirmed: Temperature-response experiments are scattered and use different endpoints.
TRY does not directly provide complete temperature-response curves for all species.
Temperate crops are heavily over-represented relative to the common wild flora.
